Update Readme.md (#231)

Providing `nul` as `sameSite` will lead to errors.

Zod requires sameSite to be a string, so the description in the
documentation was inaccurate and has been corrected.

```
ZodError: [
  {
    "code": "invalid_type",
    "expected": "string",
    "received": "null",
    "path": [
      "sameSite"
    ],
    "message": "Expected string, received null"
  }
]
```
